title: Weather & Seasons
description: Learn to talk about the weather, describe seasons, express temperature, and understand weather forecasts in Spanish.

grammar.title: Hacer + Adjective — Expressing Weather Conditions
grammar.content:
In Spanish, weather is expressed using "hacer" (to make/to do) + adjective. This is one of the most common ways to describe the weather.

Basic patterns:
Hace calor. = It's hot.
Hace frío. = It's cold.
Hace sol. = It's sunny.
Hace buen tiempo. = It's nice weather.
Hace mal tiempo. = It's bad weather.
Hace viento. = It's windy.
Hace un buen día. = It's a nice day.
Hace un mal día. = It's a bad day.

Temperature expressions:
¿Qué temperatura hace hoy? = What's the temperature today?
Hoy hace 20 grados. = Today it's 20 degrees.
Mañana hará 35 grados. = Tomorrow it will be 35 degrees.

Form (you) questions:
¿Qué tiempo hace? = What's the weather like?
¿Qué tiempo hace hoy? = What's the weather like today?
¿Cuántos grados hace? = How many degrees is it?

Note: "Hacer" for weather only appears in the third person singular (hace). It is never used in plural.
examples:
Hace sol hoy. (It's sunny today.)
Hace frío en invierno. (It's cold in winter.)
Hace calor en verano. (It's hot in summer.)
Hace mal tiempo en otoño. (It's bad weather in autumn.)
¿Qué tiempo hace? (What's the weather like?)
Hace viento. (It's windy.)
Hoy hace 25 grados. (Today it's 25 degrees.)
Mañana hará frío. (Tomorrow it will be cold.)
Hace buen día para caminar. (It's a nice day for walking.)
¿Cuántos grados hacen hoy? (How many degrees is it today?)

grammar.title: Llover, Nevar, Granizar — Weather Verbs
grammar.content:
These verbs describe specific weather conditions. They are used in the third person singular when talking about weather.

Llover = to rain
Llueve. = It's raining.
Llovió ayer. = It rained yesterday.
Va a llover. = It's going to rain.

Nevar = to snow
Nieva. = It's snowing.
Nevó mucho. = It snowed a lot.
Va a nevar. = It's going to snow.

Granizar = to hail
Graniza. = It's hailing.
Granizó ayer. = It hailed yesterday.

Impermanence structure (to express what the weather is like at a specific moment):
Está lloviendo. = It is raining (right now).
Está nevando. = It is snowing (right now).

Weather adjectives:
Lluvioso/a = rainy
Nevado/a = snowy
Ventoso/a = windy
Nublado/a = cloudy
Despejado/a = clear

Expressions:
Hoy llueve. = It's raining today.
Mañana va a nevar. = Tomorrow it's going to snow.
Ayer llovió mucho. = It rained a lot yesterday.
En primavera suele llover. = In spring it often rains.

Other weather verbs:
Temblar = to shake/quake (used in earthquakes)
Relampaguear = to lightning
Tronar = to thunder
examples:
Llueve mucho en esta ciudad. (It rains a lot in this city.)
Nieva en las montañas. (It snows in the mountains.)
¿Va a llover mañana? (Is it going to rain tomorrow?)
Sí, va a llover mañana. (Yes, it's going to rain tomorrow.)
Hoy está lloviendo. (It is raining today.)
Ayer nevó en la ciudad. (It snowed in the city yesterday.)
En invierno nieva mucho. (In winter it snows a lot.)
El cielo está nublado. (The sky is cloudy.)
El cielo está despejado. (The sky is clear.)
¿Qué tiempo hará mañana? (What will the weather be like tomorrow?)

grammar.title: Talking About Seasons — Ser + Estar + En
grammar.content:
The four seasons in Spanish:
la primavera (spring) — March, April, May
el verano (summer) — June, July, August
el otoño (autumn) — September, October, November
el invierno (winter) — December, January, February

Using "en" + season:
En primavera hace calor. = In spring it's warm.
En verano hace mucho calor. = In summer it's very hot.
En otoño llueve mucho. = In autumn it rains a lot.
En invierno hace frío. = In winter it's cold.

Season characteristics:
Primavera: florecen las flores, hace buen tiempo.
( Spring: flowers bloom, it's nice weather.)
Verano: hace sol, hace calor, vamos a la playa.
( Summer: it's sunny, it's hot, we go to the beach.)
Otoño: caen las hojas, hace frío, llueve.
( Autumn: leaves fall, it's cold, it rains.)
Invierno: nieva, hace mucho frío, usamos abrigo.
( Winter: it snows, it's very cold, we wear coats.)

Describing seasons with SER:
La primavera es bonita. = Spring is pretty.
El verano es largo. = Summer is long.
El otoño es lluvioso. = Autumn is rainy.
El invierno es frío. = Winter is cold.

Questions:
¿Cuál es tu estación favorita? = What's your favorite season?
¿Qué tiempo hace en primavera? = What's the weather like in spring?
¿En qué mes empieza el verano? = What month does summer start?
examples:
En primavera las flores florecen. (In spring the flowers bloom.)
En verano hace mucho calor. (In summer it's very hot.)
En otoño caen las hojas de los árboles. (In autumn the leaves fall from the trees.)
En invierno hace mucho frío. (In winter it's very cold.)
¿Cuál es tu estación favorita? (What's your favorite season?)
Mi estación favorita es la primavera. (My favorite season is spring.)
¿En qué mes empieza el otoño? (What month does autumn start?)
Empieza en septiembre. (It starts in September.)
El verano es la estación más larga. (Summer is the longest season.)
En invierno uso el abrigo y la bufanda. (In winter I wear a coat and a scarf.)

grammar.title: Temperature — Expressing Degrees and Comparisons
grammar.content:
Expressing temperature in Spanish:

Basic temperature expressions:
¿Cuántos grados hace hoy? = How many degrees is it today?
Hace 20 grados. = It's 20 degrees.
Hoy hace 15 grados. = Today it's 15 degrees.
Mañana hará 30 grados. = Tomorrow it will be 30 degrees.

Temperature descriptions:
Temperatura baja = low temperature
Temperatura alta = high temperature
Temperatura media = average temperature
Muy fría = very cold
Muy caliente = very hot
Templado = mild/warm
Frío = cold
Caliente = hot

Comparing temperatures:
Más frío = colder
Más calor = hotter
Más caliente = hotter
Más frío que... = colder than...
Más calor que... = hotter than...
El verano es más caliente que el invierno. (Summer is hotter than winter.)
El otoño es más frío que la primavera. (Autumn is colder than spring.)

Temperature ranges:
De cero a diez grados = from 0 to 10 degrees
De diez a veinte grados = from 10 to 20 degrees
De veinte a treinta grados = from 20 to 30 degrees
Más de treinta grados = over 30 degrees
Menos de cero grados = below zero degrees

Using "tener":
Tengo frío. = I am cold. (literally: I have cold)
Tengo calor. = I am hot. (literally: I have heat)
¿Tienes frío? = Are you cold?
No, no tengo frío. = No, I'm not cold.

Note: In Spanish, you "have" cold/heat rather than "are" cold/hot.
examples:
¿Cuántos grados hacen hoy? (How many degrees is it today?)
Hacen 25 grados. (It's 25 degrees.)
¿Tienes frío? (Are you cold?)
Sí, tengo frío. (Yes, I'm cold.)
¿Tienes calor? (Are you hot?)
No, no tengo calor. (No, I'm not hot.)
Hoy hace más calor que ayer. (Today it's hotter than yesterday.)
En verano hace mucho más calor. (In summer it's much hotter.)
La temperatura está muy baja. (The temperature is very low.)
La temperatura está muy alta. (The temperature is very high.)
Mañana hará más de treinta grados. (Tomorrow it will be over 30 degrees.)
Tengo calor y quiero un helado. (I'm hot and I want ice cream.)

grammar.title: Weather Forecast — Future and Present Tense
grammar.content:
Talking about weather forecasts using future and present tense:

Present tense (what's happening now):
Hoy hace buen tiempo. = Today it's nice weather.
Hoy llueve. = It's raining today.
Hoy nieva. = It's snowing today.
El cielo está despejado. = The sky is clear.
El cielo está nublado. = The sky is cloudy.

Future with "ir a + infinitive":
Mañana va a hacer sol. = Tomorrow it's going to be sunny.
Mañana va a llover. = Tomorrow it's going to rain.
El fin de semana va a hacer frío. = The weekend it's going to be cold.
El fin de semana va a nevar. = The weekend it's going to snow.

Future simple (hacer): hará, (llover): lloverá, (nevar): nevará
Mañana hará buen tiempo. = Tomorrow it will be nice weather.
Mañana lloverá. = Tomorrow it will rain.
El lunes nevará. = Monday it will snow.

Forecast vocabulary:
La previsión del tiempo = the weather forecast
El pronóstico = the forecast
Según el pronóstico = according to the forecast
Es probable que llueva = It's likely to rain
Puede nevar = It could snow

Questions:
¿Cuál es el pronóstico para mañana? = What's the forecast for tomorrow?
¿Va a hacer sol el fin de semana? = Is it going to be sunny on the weekend?
¿Qué tiempo va a hacer mañana? = What weather will there be tomorrow?
¿Qué tiempo hará el lunes? = What weather will there be on Monday?
examples:
La previsión del tiempo dice que va a llover. (The weather forecast says it's going to rain.)
Mañana va a hacer sol. (Tomorrow it's going to be sunny.)
El fin de semana va a hacer frío. (The weekend it's going to be cold.)
Según el pronóstico, lloverá el lunes. (According to the forecast, it will rain on Monday.)
¿Va a nevar esta noche? (Is it going to snow tonight?)
Sí, va a nevar esta noche. (Yes, it's going to snow tonight.)
¿Qué tiempo hace hoy? (What's the weather like today?)
Hoy hace buen tiempo. (Today it's nice weather.)
El cielo está despejado. (The sky is clear.)
¿Cuál es el pronóstico para mañana? (What's the forecast for tomorrow?)

exercises.question: What is 'rain' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Lluvia' = rain. 'Nieve' = snow. 'Viento' = wind. 'Sol' = sun.

exercises.question: What is 'winter' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Invierno' = winter. 'Primavera' = spring. 'Verano' = summer. 'Otoño' = autumn.

exercises.question: Complete: Hace ___ en verano. (It's hot in summer.)
exercises.explanation: 'Hace calor' = It's hot. This is the standard weather expression using 'hacer'.

exercises.question: Complete: Hoy ___ . (It's raining today.)
exercises.explanation: 'Llueve' = it's raining. From the verb 'llover' (to rain), third person singular.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'It's cold today'
exercises.explanation: 'Hoy' = today. 'Hace' = it is (weather). 'Frío' = cold. 'Hace frío' = It's cold.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'It's sunny'
exercises.explanation: 'Hace sol' = It's sunny. 'Hacer' + 'sol' is the fixed expression for sunny weather.

exercises.question: What does 'lluvioso/a' mean?
exercises.explanation: 'Lluvioso/a' = rainy. 'Ventoso/a' = windy. 'Nevado/a' = snowy. 'Despejado/a' = sunny.

exercises.question: What is 'umbrella' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Paraguas' = umbrella. 'Sombrero' = hat. 'Bufanda' = scarf. 'Guantes' = gloves.

exercises.question: Complete: En ___ llueve mucho. (In autumn it rains a lot.)
exercises.explanation: 'En otoño' = in autumn. 'Llueve mucho' = it rains a lot.

exercises.question: Complete: Tengo ___. (I'm cold.)
exercises.explanation: 'Tengo frío' = I'm cold. In Spanish, you 'have' cold, not 'are' cold.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'The sky is cloudy'
exercises.explanation: 'El cielo' = the sky. 'Está' = is (current state). 'Nublado' = cloudy. Use ESTAR for current conditions.

exercises.question: What is 'tomorrow' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Mañana' = tomorrow. 'Hoy' = today. 'Ayer' = yesterday. 'Siempre' = always.

exercises.question: What is 'snow' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Nieve' = snow. 'Lluvia' = rain. 'Viento' = wind. 'Niebla' = fog.

exercises.question: Complete: Mañana va a ___. (Tomorrow it's going to rain.)
exercises.explanation: 'Va a llover' = It's going to rain. 'Ir a + infinitive' = going to + verb.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'I'm hot'
exercises.explanation: 'Tengo calor' = I'm hot. In Spanish, you 'have' heat, not 'are' hot.

exercises.question: What is 'spring' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Primavera' = spring. 'Invierno' = winter. 'Verano' = summer. 'Otoño' = autumn.

exercises.question: Complete: En verano hace ___. (In summer it's hot.)
exercises.explanation: 'Hace calor' = it's hot. 'En verano' = in summer.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'It's windy'
exercises.explanation: 'Hace viento' = It's windy. 'Hacer' + 'viento' is the standard expression for windy weather.

exercises.question: What does 'despejado/a' mean?
exercises.explanation: 'Despejado/a' = clear/sunny. 'Nublado/a' = cloudy. 'Lluvioso/a' = rainy. 'Niebla' = fog.

exercises.question: What is 'beach' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Playa' = beach. 'Montaña' = mountain. 'Bosque' = forest. 'Río' = river.

exercises.question: Complete: En ___ hace mucho frío. (In winter it's very cold.)
exercises.explanation: 'En invierno' = in winter. 'Hace mucho frío' = it's very cold.

exercises.question: Complete: Hoy hace ___ grados. (Today it's 25 degrees.)
exercises.explanation: 'Veinticinco' = twenty-five. 'Hace veinticinco grados' = It's 25 degrees.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'The weather forecast says it's going to rain'
exercises.correct: el pronóstico dice que va a llover
exercises.explanation: 'El pronóstico' = the forecast. 'Dice' = says. 'Que va a llover' = that it's going to rain.

exercises.question: What is 'forest' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Bosque' = forest. 'Campo' = countryside. 'Costa' = coast. 'Lago' = lake.

exercises.question: Complete: El cielo está ___. (The sky is clear.)
exercises.explanation: 'Despejado' = clear/sunny. 'El cielo está despejado' = The sky is clear.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'What's the weather like today?'
exercises.explanation: 'Qué tiempo' = what weather. 'Hace' = is (weather). 'Hoy' = today. '¿Qué tiempo hace hoy?' = What's the weather like today?

exercises.question: What is 'mountain' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Montaña' = mountain. 'Playa' = beach. 'Lago' = lake. 'Costa' = coast.

exercises.question: Complete: En primavera florecen las ___. (In spring the flowers bloom.)
exercises.explanation: 'Flores' = flowers. 'Florecen' = they bloom. 'En primavera' = in spring.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'It's going to snow tomorrow'
exercises.explanation: 'Mañana' = tomorrow. 'Va a nevar' = it's going to snow. 'Ir a + nevar' = going to snow.

exercises.question: What is 'autumn' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Otoño' = autumn. 'Primavera' = spring. 'Verano' = summer. 'Invierno' = winter.

exercises.question: Complete: El cielo está ___. (The sky is cloudy.)
exercises.explanation: 'Nublado' = cloudy. 'El cielo está nublado' = The sky is cloudy. Use ESTAR for current conditions.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'I have cold'
exercises.explanation: 'Tengo frío' = I'm cold. In Spanish, you 'have' cold: 'tener frío' = to be cold.

exercises.question: What is 'sea' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Mar' = sea. 'Río' = river. 'Lago' = lake. 'Playa' = beach.

exercises.question: Complete: Hace ___ en invierno. (It's cold in winter.)
exercises.explanation: 'Hace frío' = It's cold. 'En invierno' = in winter.

exercises.question: Complete: ___ llueve en esta ciudad. (It rains a lot in this city.)
exercises.explanation: 'Mucho' = a lot. 'Mucho llueve' is less common; 'Llueve mucho' is more natural: 'It rains a lot.'

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'It's raining today'
exercises.explanation: 'Hoy' = today. 'Llueve' = it's raining. 'Hoy llueve' = It's raining today.

exercises.question: What does 'templado/a' mean?
exercises.explanation: 'Templado/a' = mild/warm. 'Muy frío' = very cold. 'Muy caliente' = very hot.

exercises.question: What is 'frog' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Rana' = frog. 'Perro' = dog. 'Gato' = cat. 'Pájaro' = bird.

exercises.question: Complete: En otoño caen las ___. (In autumn the leaves fall.)
exercises.explanation: 'Hojas' = leaves (plural of 'hoja'). 'Caen' = they fall. 'En otoño' = in autumn.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'The weather forecast'
exercises.explanation: 'La previsión del tiempo' = the weather forecast. 'Pronóstico' is also used for forecast.

exercises.question: What is 'lake' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Lago' = lake. 'Río' = river. 'Mar' = sea. 'Playa' = beach.

exercises.question: Complete: Mañana hará ___. (Tomorrow it will be sunny.)
exercises.explanation: 'Hará sol' = it will be sunny. 'Hacer' future tense: 'hará'. 'Mañana hará sol' = Tomorrow it will be sunny.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'Summer is hot'
exercises.explanation: 'El verano' = summer. 'Es' = is (permanent characteristic, SER). 'Caliente' = hot. Use SER for descriptions.

exercises.question: What is 'rainbow' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Arcoíris' = rainbow. 'Niebla' = fog. 'Brisa' = breeze. 'Rocío' = dew.

exercises.question: Complete: El otoño es ___ . (Autumn is rainy.)
exercises.explanation: 'Lluvioso' = rainy. 'El otoño es lluvioso' = Autumn is rainy. 'Es' = is (description, SER).

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'Do you have cold?'
exercises.explanation: '¿Tienes' = Do you have (from 'tener'). 'Frío' = cold. '¿Tienes frío?' = Are you cold?

exercises.question: What is 'scarf' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Bufanda' = scarf. 'Sombrero' = hat. 'Guantes' = gloves. 'Abrigo' = coat.

exercises.question: Complete: Hoy hace ___ . (Today it's nice weather.)
exercises.explanation: 'Hace buen tiempo' = It's nice weather. 'Buen' = good (short form before masculine noun).

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'It's going to rain this weekend'
exercises.correct: va a llover este fin de semana
exercises.explanation: 'Va a llover' = it's going to rain. 'Este fin de semana' = this weekend. 'Ir a + infinitive' for future.

exercises.question: What is 'fog' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Niebla' = fog. 'Nieve' = snow. 'Lluvia' = rain. 'Viento' = wind.

exercises.question: Complete: En ___ hace mucho sol. (In summer it's very sunny.)
exercises.explanation: 'En verano' = in summer. 'Hace mucho sol' = it's very sunny.
